submitted.rationale: AgSbO3 is on the hull (MACE) with a predicted ~1.8 eV gap, so it absorbs 2.7 eV light. Measured EQE: index 4 (Ag 0.54) 0.372%, index 5 (Ag 0.50) 0.369%, index 9 (Ag 0.36) 0.161%. The peak is at or just Ag-rich of the 1:1 AgSbO3 composition.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.16%; EQE falls on the Sb-rich side
Ag3SbO4 predicted near-metallic (gap 0.09 eV); not measured

consultations.verdict: Support: AgSbO3 (mp-545999) is on hull (MACE Ehull 0) with HSE-level gap ~1.8 eV (<2.7 eV photons, absorbs). Index 5 (Ag 0.50) is the stoichiometric composition for this phase.

Against the Ag-rich side: Ag3SbO4 is predicted near-metallic (gap 0.09 eV), so Ag-rich samples are unlikely to beat index 5. The Sb-rich oxide SbO4-type phase has a 1.6 eV gap, so an AgSbO3 plus Sb-oxide mix may still absorb. That supports probing the moderately Sb-rich index 9 (Ag 0.36).

Ag3SbO4 is slightly above the hull (0.017 eV/atom) and near-metallic, so a slightly Ag-rich film should still be mostly AgSbO3. EQE dropped on the Sb-rich side (0.16 vs 0.37), so the peak is probably at or just Ag-rich of 1:1. I'll probe index 4 (Ag 0.54).
